rulings.rationale: Raw V9 correctly roots E1 at sensitivity. The frozen root mismatch is a cascade from the event-type projection mismatch.
ASSOCIATION differs from CG Regulation, but Regulation is not scientifically compelled. V11's wrong trigger and root are separately classified source-semantic errors.
There is no disagreement. TS and DPD belong to separately documented outer E7 and E8 events and are not required participants of the requested focus event E9.
Raw V9 source roles attach the population and drug to sensitivity. The frozen link failure is downstream of grounding and projection failures.
POPULATION is the entity type and AFFECTED_ENTITY is the source-semantic event role.
